deep.writeup:
Volmex is the premier benchmark index company that created the leading Bitcoin volatility index — **BVIV, known as the “VIX for Bitcoin”** — and is now expanding into compute indices, prediction-market indices and more.

**Where BVIV is used:** Polymarket, Hyperliquid, Bloomberg Terminal, TradingView, Bybit, Raydium, Bitfinex and others.

**Team:** from Staked (acquired by Kraken), IMC Trading, RBC and more.
**Backers:** Anatoly Yakovenko (founder of Solana), Sandeep Nailwal (founder of Polygon), Robot Ventures and more.

**How to use the BVIV perp on Hyperliquid (HIP-3)** — BVIV is 30-day BTC implied volatility:
• Speculate on BTC implied volatility
• Hedge or diversify spot BTC
• Mean-reversion strategies
• Arbitrage against other BVIV Index perpetuals or options

Trade it: https://app.hyperliquid.xyz/trade/mkts:BVIV
Website: https://volmex.finance

projects.name: Gage
projects.what: No-liquidation, fixed-cost loans on Robinhood Chain — the borrower can walk away at expiry, so every loan carries an embedded put
projects.note: Reported a burn of 38,682,841 sGAGE and cumulative buybacks of slightly over 5.4% of GAGE supply for $55,754.

deep.thesis: Options in loan form. Pledging NVDA for USDG with the right to walk away at expiry is economically a put struck at the reclaim cap: the borrower is long the put, lenders are short it and earn the fixed cost as premium. No oracle and no liquidation in the deal path — the decision happens only at expiry.
catalysts: V2 engine live with Earn vaults run by curators
Robinhood Chain stock tokens as collateral
risks: Lenders take the collateral if the borrower walks — a short-put payoff
Thin onchain exit liquidity for memes and small tokens
Early-stage protocol on a new chain

timeline.text: New Earn vault curator JollyDinger (stock-token liquidity); 54.2M sGAGE burned

projects.name: SuperVega
projects.what: Touch options on Starknet — pick a price target and a date; if price touches it, you get paid. Defined cost, no liquidation
projects.note: Enabled private options trading through STRK20 Shadow Accounts, separating positions from the user’s main public wallet.

deep.thesis: Barrier-style payoffs for retail: a one-touch option settles the moment price taps the strike, so a flash wick pays out instead of liquidating you — the opposite of perps.
catalysts: STRK volatility — the only venue listing STRK options, per the team
Social copy-trading links
risks: Touch options are priced off volatility; premiums can be rich in fast markets

projects.name: Saffron
projects.what: Fixed vs variable yield on Uniswap LPs — LPs lock a fixed rate, traders buy the future fee stream (a leveraged bet on volume and volatility)

deep.thesis: Not an options venue, but options-adjacent: Uniswap LP fees rise with trading volume and volatility, so buying the variable side is a long-volatility-style trade, and the fixed side sells that exposure for a known rate.
catalysts: Tokenized-stock pools on Robinhood Chain
SFI relisted on Indodax (Oct 8, 2026)
risks: Variable side loses if volume dries up

projects.name: IVY
projects.what: Intent-based options for any token — state the outcome you want and IVY quotes the strike, expiry and price; long-tail assets included

deep.thesis: Most onchain options venues list a fixed menu of strikes and expiries, so long-tail tokens never get a market. IVY flips it: you state the outcome (or the minimum APR you want) and the protocol prices and opens that market — options for every token, not just BTC and ETH.
catalysts: Early-access launch
Token issuers using it to create options on their own token
risks: Pre-launch — no live volume yet
Long-tail options can be thinly hedged and expensive

timeline.text: Explains intent-based quoting: no side reveals its minimum
Custom strikes and maturities instead of a pre-packaged chain
“Introducing IVY — the options layer for every token”
